svg.data-what: a block of skin cut open: the epidermis and its layers on top, the dermis with a hair follicle, glands, vessels and nerves, the fat of the hypodermis below

path.data-what: the hypodermis, the layer of fat under the skin: insulation, padding and energy store
the reticular dermis, dense collagen and elastic fibres that make skin strong and stretchy
the papillary dermis, loose tissue rising into the papillae that lock into the epidermis, with capillary loops
the stratum basale, one row of dividing cells on the basement membrane, with the melanocytes among them
the stratum spinosum, keratinocytes held together by many desmosomes
the stratum granulosum, cells filling with keratin granules as they begin to die

g.data-what: the stratum corneum, flat dead cells full of keratin, shed and renewed about every month: the barrier
arteries and arterioles of the skin, rising from a network under the dermis to capillary loops in each papilla
veins of the skin, draining the capillaries back down
a sweat gland: a coiled tube deep in the dermis, its duct spiralling up to a pore; sweat cools by evaporating

path.data-what: a sebaceous gland, emptying oily sebum into the hair follicle
the arrector pili, a tiny smooth muscle that pulls the hair upright: goose bumps

g.data-what: a hair follicle, the pocket of epidermis that grows a hair from its bulb, deep in the skin

path.data-what: the dermal papilla of the hair, the knot of dermis and capillaries that feeds the growing hair
the hair shaft, dead keratinised cells pushed out of the follicle

g.data-what: a sensory nerve of the skin, with free endings reaching into the epidermis for pain and temperature
a Pacinian corpuscle, an onion of layers deep in the dermis that senses vibration and pressure

path.data-what: a Meissner corpuscle, in a papilla just under the epidermis: light touch
